independent_oracle: Hand calculation in the check itself, plus the committed Run-19 category oracles: oracles_cat_9.cadence_report for cessation and timeliness_state for the future-dated case, both self-proving against the specification at import

defect_class: a governance or regulatory module making an overstated compliance or authority claim
theory_source: Committed supervisory specification section 17, whose governing rule is that a rule check is not a legal determination, plus sections 8.2, 8.3 and 8.4 and the Category 8 regulatory ledger at REGULATORY_SNAPSHOT_2026-08-12; section 19 for 10.3
independent_oracle: run17/oracle/oracles_cat_8.py, self proved at import: the four applicability states, the four rule results with absent evidence resolving to Insufficient Evidence and never Satisfied, the four reporting-compliance results, and says_prohibited over the category's forbidden claim forms. Web retrieval of the primary sources was ATTEMPTED and FAILED, every official host being refused at the egress proxy; a general web search corroborated the snapshot's text of FAR 34.201 and is recorded as corroboration only, not as a primary source read
defect_reproduced: yes, all four. 8.2 and 10.3 were registered Run-19 propositions and the harness fails a registered proposition that starts to hold, so the pre-fix and post-fix reds are both named. 8.3 and 8.4 were reproduced directly on the emitted sentence
fix_summary: 8.2 the twenty-five per cent level is named an internal review level with its provenance carried, the regulation's name and part number are gone from the sentence and the fields, and the result records that no regulatory determination was made. 8.3 MANDATORY REPORTING TRIGGERED is removed and the two conditions remain as internal observations. 8.4 the three flags are renamed from breach to a performance index below an internal review level and the result states that reporting compliance is not assessed. 10.3 the rule named FAR threshold is renamed for the forecast-overrun comparison it makes. NO THRESHOLD, BOUNDARY, BAND OR ARITHMETIC RESULT CHANGED IN ANY OF THE FOUR
mutation_proof: 6 mutations, each confirmed to change bytes, each producing a named red and restoring green: M7 the FAR attribution restored; M8 MANDATORY REPORTING TRIGGERED restored; M9 the breach language restored; M10 the FAR rule name restored; M11 a delivered fix undeclared in the manifest; M12 an undeclared production edit. M11 did not qualify on its first attempt and the reason is recorded rather than hidden
neighbour_sweep: see code_audit/run20_neighbour_sweep_results.csv, five sweeps, three new findings: 10.3 carrying the same fabricated threshold in a rule name; 8.3's unreachable Yellow arm, carried forward as P1; and the discovery that cycle 1's own declared-manifest guard could not fail, which is fixed here
category9_lineage_check: no change to qualification or lineage state. All four modules are non-voting and advisory, no band moved, so no downstream signal changed value. What changed is what the reader is told about the basis of a band
regression: complete suite rerun through the strict runner; 8353 checks green before the cycle and 8398 after, across 98 suites, with two pre-existing suites corrected and one new suite added
commit_message: Run 20 cycle 2: a rule check is not a legal determination
